_: Veo 3.1. Three speed tiers, each with five routes. Price depends on resolution and audio together and the two do not multiply, which is what `scale.and` is for: the audio surcharge doubles the price at 720p and adds half at 4K.

fal-ai/veo3.1.description: The full model. What Veo looks like when nothing is traded away. Here, writing a clip from a sentence.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.2 per second of output without audio and $0.4 with it, at 720p and 1080p; at 4K it is $0.4 without and $0.6 with. Priced from 1080p with audio, which is the default, and scaled from there. The four rates are not a product of two factors, so they are keyed on both controls together.
